sections.title: What {{SITE_NAME}} is, and the medical, nutrition and allergen disclaimer

blocks.text: {{SITE_NAME}} helps you track what is in your kitchen, scan receipts, find and import recipes, plan meals and follow your nutrition.

blocks.title: Important: this is not medical advice
items: {{SITE_NAME}} is an **informational kitchen and meal-planning tool**. It is **not a medical device, a healthcare provider, or a licensed dietitian**, and it does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition.

Receipts read by AI, nutrition-label scans, macro estimates for restaurant and outside meals, BMR and Katch-McArdle calorie and macro calculations, and allergen and dietary filters are **automated approximations that can contain errors**. A filter can miss an allergen. A scan can misread a label.

**If you have a food allergy, an intolerance or a medical condition, you must always check the physical product label yourself**, and consult a qualified physician before changing your diet. Do not rely on {{SITE_NAME}} to tell you a food is safe for you.

Calorie and macro targets, including weight-loss targets, are general estimates for healthy adults. They are not suitable as the sole guide for anyone who is under 18, pregnant or breastfeeding, has or has had an eating disorder, or has a condition affected by diet. **If you are under 18, do not follow a calorie-deficit or weight-loss target without your parent or guardian and a doctor.**

Recipes, shelf-life and expiry estimates, ingredient matches and food images are generated by AI models (Google Gemini and Imagen). They are **probabilistic outputs**: they may be inaccurate, incomplete, or not match the real dish.

**Food safety is your responsibility.** Follow safe food handling, cook to safe temperatures, and check food for spoilage yourself before eating it. An expiry estimate in the app is not proof that food is safe, and a missing warning is not proof either.

When you paste or share a recipe link (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a blog), we fetch the public page and extract ingredients and steps for your own use. The original content belongs to its creator. Import only content you are allowed to access and use, and do not republish someone else's recipe as your own.
We may limit how much AI processing an account can use, to keep the service fair and affordable.
